title: 25:8 He will swallow up death in victory. Christ victoriously overcame death at his resurrection and made it possible for us also to swallow up death in victory. Paul quoted this passage: "So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory. . . . Thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ" (1 Cor. 15:54-57; see also Hel. 14:14-18).
author: Tina M. Peterson
